proposal.name: vite
proposal.rationale: The SBOM declares vite@8.3.5. Registry lookup confirms vite exists in npm (E1). Version listing before the SBOM timestamp shows 8.3.5 as the highest-probability candidate (0.111 prior) among available versions (E2). The SBOM's own confidence scores also rank 8.3.5 highest at 0.194. Version 8.3.5 satisfies all constraints and was available before the SBOM generation time.
